description: This source file contains the definition of the SubscriptionStatus class, which manages CRUD operations and related functionality for subscription status entities within the Opencart admin localisation model.

classes.name: SubscriptionStatus
classes.description: Manages CRUD operations and related functionalities for subscription status entities in the localisation module.

methods.name: addSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Adds a new subscription status entry for multiple languages and returns its ID.

methods.name: editSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Updates an existing subscription status by ID, including its descriptions per language.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Deletes a subscription status record from the database.

methods.name: getSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a subscription status by ID for the current language.

methods.name: getSubscriptionStatuses
methods.description: Fetches a list of subscription statuses, optionally ordered and paginated.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionStatuses
methods.description: Returns the total count of subscription statuses for the current language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds or updates the description for a subscription status in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches descriptions for a subscription status across all languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves descriptions for subscription statuses filtered by a specific language ID.
